title: Shapath Nilam
desc: Sukanta is shattered when his wife, Minu, is raped on their honeymoon. Though his wife fails to recognise him after the incident, her twin sister, Debu, tries to find the culprit.

title: Mejo Bou
desc: Barun's father forces him to marry Sampa, a colleague from a middle-class background. After the marriage, Barun creates problems for his new wife and damages her reputation.

title: Dan Protidan
desc: Ashok becomes distraught following the demise of his wife. In a bid to usurp his wealth, Dilip, Ashok's cousin, takes advantage of the situation and begins to torture him.

title: Bourani
desc: A manipulative woman schemes to control her brother's wealth by orchestrating a marriage, but her plans begin to unravel when unexpected love enters the picture.
